mentions.name: Bio tools
mentions.description: A CLI app and Python/Rust library for installing and running structural biology and drug-design software, handling the setup so users don't have to manage Python environments, conda, or system dependencies themselves.
mentions.problem: Running structural bio/drug-design software normally requires users to mess with Python environments, conda, and system dependencies.
mentions.source_excerpt: Bio tools: CLI app, Python or rust lib for installing and running structural bio/drug-design software without the user messing with python envs, conda, system deps etc: https://github.com/David-OConnor/bio_tools
